props.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
props.title: Gel Nails & Nail Art Seminyak: FAQs

items.question: Is gel nail art better than regular nail polish?
items.answer: Gel nail art generally lasts longer and keeps its shine better than traditional nail polish, which makes it a popular choice for holidays and special occasions. Gel typically lasts two to three weeks.

items.question: Can I bring my own nail design reference?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, you're welcome to show inspiration photos so our nail artists can recreate a similar style that suits your nails, preferred colours and occasion. Most nail art appointments take 45 to 90 minutes, depending on the design.

items.question: Will gel nails damage my natural nails?
items.answer: No, not when gel is applied and removed correctly. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, our team works gently, from nail preparation and cuticle care to UV or LED curing and a protective top coat. Gel removal for hands and feet costs IDR 98.000 per person.

items.question: How long does a nail art appointment take?
items.answer: Most nail art appointments at Spa Bali Moon take between 45 and 90 minutes, depending on the complexity of the design. For gel nail art, the process covers nail preparation and shaping, cuticle care, gel application, a hand-created design, UV or LED curing and a protective top coat. Bring a reference photo if you have one.

items.question: How long does gel nail art last?
items.answer: Gel nail art from Spa Bali Moon typically lasts around two to three weeks, depending on nail growth and daily activities. The gel is cured under UV or LED light and finished with a protective top coat. Nail gel costs IDR 219.000 per person for hands or feet, or IDR 438.000 for both.

items.question: What is nail art?
items.answer: Nail art is the decoration of fingernails or toenails using colours, patterns, designs or other decorative details, added to natural nails or applied over gel or polish. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, popular styles include minimalist designs, French tips, chrome finishes and floral patterns.

items.question: How much does gel nail art cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Nail gel costs IDR 219.000 per person for hands or feet at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, or IDR 438.000 for both. A manicure with colour is IDR 159.000 and a pedicure with colour IDR 169.000. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Gel typically lasts two to three weeks.

items.question: Can I have gel nails done at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with everything your nails need. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book gel nails for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my gel nails?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your gel nails on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
